APPENDIX 207

Two nests of the common Willow-Warbler were found and others were seen building in the Shetlands in May, 1901.

The Wood-Warbler was heard on the Isle of Man, in May 1901 and 1905.

---

**Family—TURDIDÆ.**
**Subfamily—SYLVIINÆ.**

**THE RUFOUS WARBLER.**
**Aedon galactodes, TEMM.**

**T**HIS rare species has occurred in Sussex and Devon in the autumn.

---

**Family—TURDIDÆ.**
**Subfamily—SYLVIINÆ.**

**THE GREY-BACKED WARBLER.**
**Aedon familiaris.**

**A** male was shot at Hythe, Kent, on July 15th, 1907.

---

**Family—TURDIDÆ.**
**Subfamily—SYLVIINÆ.**

**RADDE’S BUSH-WARBLER.**
**Lusciniola schwarzi, RADDE.**

**A** specimen was obtained in October, 1898, on the Lincolnshire side of the Humber, by Mr. Haigh.
